An airplane $A$ is flying horizontally at a constant height of $800\,\text{m}$ above the ground. The angle of elevation $\theta $ made by the airplane and a nearby radar station $R$ is decreasing at a rate of $0.05$ radians per second. What is the speed of the aircraft as a function of $\theta ?$
